previous_statement: Let e_1 be the first coordinate column and define B=Xe_1^* and A_0=B^dagger=e_1X^dagger. From X in M_{n,1} tensor S_{P,Q}, entrywise zero-padding yields only B in M_n tensor S_{P,Q}; dagger yields only A_0 in M_n tensor S_{Q,P}. None of def-hcb-datum, def-column-hilbert-corner, lem-compcb-rectangular-product, or lem-compcb-compressed-unit-norm identifies these spaces with S_{P_n,Q_n} and S_{Q_n,P_n}. Hence compatibility of (A_0,B) for lem-compcb-rectangular-product is not established under this shard's exact allowed inputs, and the former affirmative compatibility claim is withdrawn.
new_statement: Let e_1 be the first coordinate column and define B=Xe_1^* and A_0=B^dagger=e_1X^dagger. From X in M_{n,1} tensor S_{P,Q}, entrywise zero-padding yields only B in M_n tensor S_{P,Q}; entrywise adjunction yields only A_0 in M_n tensor (S_{P,Q})^dagger, where (S_{P,Q})^dagger={x^dagger:x in S_{P,Q}}. None of def-hcb-datum, def-column-hilbert-corner, lem-compcb-rectangular-product, or lem-compcb-compressed-unit-norm establishes either M_n tensor S_{P,Q}=S_{P_n,Q_n} or (S_{P,Q})^dagger subseteq S_{Q,P} (and hence does not establish A_0 in S_{Q_n,P_n}). Therefore compatibility of (A_0,B) for lem-compcb-rectangular-product is not established under this shard's exact allowed inputs, and the former affirmative compatibility and S_{Q,P}-membership claims are withdrawn.
